title: Eraser tool shows a rectangular selection-style marquee during drag instead of just the eraser disk cursor
description:
USER-REPORTED UI bug. When the Eraser tool is active and you DRAG on the stage, an orange dashed RECTANGLE with a translucent orange fill is drawn bounding the entire drag path — it looks like a rectangular selection marquee. Flash 8's eraser shows ONLY a round eraser-tip cursor; it never draws a bounding rectangle.

REPRO (Playwright on :1420, confirmed with screenshot /tmp/eraser-drag.png): select the Eraser tool via its toolbar button (title 'Eraser (E)'; confirm __flashTest.getActiveTool()==='eraser'), press+drag a diagonal across the stage. An orange dashed rect (border 1px dashed #ff6600, background rgba(255,100,0,0.1)) appears spanning the drag bbox, alongside the small eraser disk cursor. DOM check getComputedStyle on the overlay div = dashed + rgb(255,102,0) returns true mid-drag.

ROOT CAUSE (file:line, packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx):
- The eraser DOES already render a correct disk cursor: cursor:none for tool==='eraser' (~line 1348) + a circular overlay div (borderRadius:50%, sized eraserSize) at ~lines 4852-4868, positioned at eraserCursorPos.
- BUT on every eraser mouse-MOVE during a drag the handler also sets eraserPreview to the bounding rect of the whole drag path: ~lines 2820-2825 (minX/minY/maxX/maxY over all drag points, expanded by eraserSize/2) -> setEraserPreview({x,y,w,h}).
- That eraserPreview is rendered as the orange dashed rect overlay at ~lines 4834-4850.
This is NOT a selection-marquee fallthrough (the eraser does real-time vector erase on shapeDisplayObjects, ~line 2837+); it is a spurious leftover preview rectangle. The eraser tool does NOT enter the arrow/FreeTransform marquee branches.

FIX DIRECTION: remove the eraserPreview bounding-rect entirely — stop setting it (drop the setEraserPreview call ~2825 and the eraserPreview state) and delete its overlay block (~4834-4850). The disk cursor (~4852-4868) + the real-time erase already give correct Flash-8 feedback. Leave the disk-cursor rendering and the cursor:none mapping untouched.

ACCEPTANCE: dragging the eraser shows only the round disk cursor, no dashed bounding rectangle (re-run the repro: the dashed-orange-rect DOM check returns false during a drag).

Found by autonomous QA e2e agent at HEAD 5217287c0ced3b155a6fd6694866b18f6fdeaf07.
